results.input: Cho mình công thức nấu phở bò với.

result.actual_text:
Dưới đây là công thức nấu phở bò đơn giản:

### Nguyên liệu:
- 500g thịt bò (thịt bắp hoặc thịt gầu)
- 1kg xương bò
- 1 củ hành tây
- 1 củ gừng
- 2-3 thanh quế
- 3-4 hoa hồi
- 1-2 nhánh thảo quả
- Muối, đường, nước mắm
- Bánh phở
- Rau thơm (húng quế, ngò gai, giá đỗ)
- Chanh, ớt tươi

### Cách làm:

1. **Nấu nước dùng:**
   - Rửa sạch xương bò, cho vào nồi nước sôi khoảng 5 phút để loại bỏ tạp chất, sau đó vớt ra.
   - Cho xương vào nồi lớn, đổ nước vào ngập xương, thêm hành tây và gừng đã nướng sơ qua.
   - Đun sôi, sau đó hạ lửa nhỏ và ninh trong khoảng 2-3 giờ để nước dùng ngọt.

2. **Chuẩn bị thịt bò:**
   - Thịt bò rửa sạch, có thể thái lát mỏng hoặc để nguyên miếng.
   - Nếu thích ăn tái, bạn có thể cho thịt vào nồi nước dùng trong 1-2 phút trước khi dọn.

3. **Nêm gia vị:**
   - Khi nước dùng đã đủ ngọt, thêm quế, hoa hồi, thảo quả, muối, đường và nước mắm vào nồi. Nêm nếm cho vừa khẩu vị.

4. **Luộc bánh phở:**
   - Luộc bánh phở trong nước sôi khoảng 1-2 phút, sau đó vớt ra để ráo.

5. **Trình bày:**
   - Cho bánh phở vào tô, xếp thịt bò lên trên, sau đó chan nước dùng nóng lên.
   - Trang trí với rau thơm, giá đỗ, chanh và ớt tươi.

### Thưởng thức:
Phở bò thường được ăn kèm với nước chấm và các loại rau sống. Chúc bạn thành công với món phở bò!

items.summary: # Top 10 robotics developments of October 2026. October 2026 was a whirlwind month for the robotics industry. items.title: DEEP Robotics Unveils Five Research Advances in Embodied AI - markets.businessinsider.com
items.summary: BOSTON, Oct. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- DEEP Robotics has unveiled five research advances supporting the development of DEEPRobotics-Brain, its embodied intelligence architecture for real-world robot operation. Spanning physical prediction, navigation and manipulation, policy optimization, predictive memory, and data-driven evaluation, the research addresses a shared challenge: helping robots work reliably in environments that change. The five research areas comprise the DR-WM-1.0 world model, the DR-VLA-2.0 embodied foundation model, the DR-APO policy optimization framework, the DR-Agent embodied agent, and the DR-Benchmark data and evaluation platform. Together, the studies connect physical prediction, navigation and manipulation, policy learning, dynamic memory, and real-world data. The research supports DEEP Robotics’ broader goal of developing robots that can respond to human instructions and practical operating conditions, with capabilities evaluated through simulation, real-robot experiments, and shared benchmarks. Developed with researchers from Zhejiang University, the Beijing Institute of Technology, Tsinghua University, MIT, and the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, DR-WM-1.0 addresses this gap by incorporating robot–terrain contact dynamics into action consequence prediction.

items.title: RoboBusiness rebrands as Robotics Summit & Expo West - The Robot Report
items.summary: # RoboBusiness rebrands as Robotics Summit & Expo West. Arrowfly, an award-winning B2B media and marketing company, today announced that RoboBusiness, the leading robotics industry event for the past 20 years, is being rebranded as Robotics Summit & Expo West, a conference and expo dedicated to the design, deployment, and scaling of commercial robots and businesses. “The robotics industry has matured, and the hardest problems have grown with it,” said Steve Crowe, executive editor of The Robot Report and chair of the Robotics Summit. Robotics Summit & Expo West will serve that community by sharing lessons from industry leaders on how to move from a pilot that works to a product deployed across multiple sites and building a business that can support it.”. Robotics Summit & Expo West is organized around the questions that define the post-prototype stage of a robotics company:. Robotics Summit & Expo West focuses on scaling the product and the company behind it.

items.title: Neura Robotics launches multimodal AI model that gives robots perception and memory - Robotics & Automation News
items.summary: # Neura Robotics launches multimodal AI model that gives robots perception and memory. **Neura Robotics has launched Neuron AI, its multimodal foundation model for physical AI.**. Combining 3D vision, touch, audio, robot state and language with memory, Neuron AI enables robots to act on information beyond what cameras alone can capture, as well as retain relevant context when objects disappear from view. “With Neuron AI, we are building the brain of the physical world: Physical AI that turns human expertise and physical experience into capabilities robots can learn and apply. The additional senses also improve tasks that vision can already handle: in welding, for example, the quality of a seam can be judged from the sound of the process. Real-world robot data: Robots across different embodiments perform tasks in Neura Gyms, Neura’s training infrastructure for cognitive robots and Physical AI and real-world environments, generating synchronized vision, touch, force, audio and movement data.

items.title: Gemini Robotics 2.5: Accelerating Physical Intelligence — Google DeepMind
items.summary: Today, we are introducing Gemini Robotics 2.5, our most capable vision-language-action (VLA) model to date. Gemini Robotics 2.5 increases both the breadth of skills a robot can learn and the speed at which it can acquire them. This enhances dexterity, reliability, and safety to help robots step out of the lab and into more unstructured, real-world environments, where they can assist people with a greater range of tasks. [...] Using our embodied reasoning model (Gemini Robotics ER) to keep track of the workflow, and the Gemini Robotics 2.5 actions model to control its hands and arms, the robot reaches into supply bins, picks up metal automotive brackets, and places them into sequencing containers, all while correcting for any gaps. Achieving a 96% success rate, this pilot shows promising progress toward widespread real-world industrial applications. [...] Gemini Robotics 2.5 uses inference-time reasoning guidance to steer around physical hazards in real-time. Much like safety classifiers add a protective layer around Gemini’s responses, this guidance allows the robot to navigate complex environments securely. In our evaluations, this capability boosted safe task completion around obstacles by 33% and around nearby people by 43%.
